outcome: Text a user typed before hydration survives it instead of being reset to the server-rendered value

acceptance_criteria.text: A value the user typed into a text input before hydration is still there after the component hydrates, rather than being replaced by the server-rendered one.

expected_verification.assertion: hydrating a v-model text input whose live value differs from the server-rendered markup leaves the live value in place

acceptance_criteria.text: The value the hydration comparison reads is normalised the way the DOM normalises it, so a field the user never touched is not mistaken for one they edited.

expected_verification.assertion: the hydration test asserts the live value survives, which fails without the normalisation because the server-rendered value and the live value differ only by newline handling
